name: Julian
source:
Class: Sorcerer

Introverted, kind, and gentle, Julian is a college student who dreams of working in the games industry.

He’s a huge Lost Heroes nerd and spends most of his free time on the MMO, doing raids with his close friend and guildmate Verdant. 

[From [url=https://gallium-games.itch.io/guilded-hearts]official page[/url]]

His default in-game nickname is Ellendi.

Class: Sorcerer
